CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_PlantillaCorreo_ObtenerPlantilla]
@ClavePlantilla AS VARCHAR(100) 

AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @PlantillaCorreoFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		PlantillaCorreo_Id INT		
	)
	

   BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @PlantillaCorreoFilter (PlantillaCorreo_Id)
		SELECT 
			[PlantillaCorreo].Id
		FROM [dbo].[PlantillaCorreo]
		WHERE
			 ([PlantillaCorreo].[ClavePlantilla] like '%' +  @ClavePlantilla) 
 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[PlantillaCorreo].[Id],
		[PlantillaCorreo].[Subject],
		[PlantillaCorreo].[ContenidoHTML]		
	FROM @PlantillaCorreoFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[PlantillaCorreo] 
			ON [PlantillaCorreo].[Id] = filter.[PlantillaCorreo_Id] 
			
					 
END
